description: Typed Open-Meteo client: Forecast, Ensemble (every member), Previous Runs, Historical Forecast, Single Runs and archive APIs, with explicit model choice and any variable by name.
Typed aviationweather.gov client: METAR/SPECI observations, TAFs and the bulk METAR cache, with raw report text and exact remark T-group temperatures.
Typed U.S. EIA Open Data API v2 client: any route and facet, auto-pagination past 5,000 rows, plus helpers for WTI/Brent spot prices and weekly petroleum stocks.
Typed Deribit client: option chains, book summaries and historical trades over REST, plus a WebSocket feed of trades, order books with gap detection, tickers with IV and greeks, DVOL and indices.
